author: The Infographics Show
description:
Harvard MBAs can’t find jobs. Nearly 1 in 5 graduates is unemployed, and the reason has nothing to do with intelligence, effort, or degrees.

Across the economy, hiring is collapsing. High-paying industries are cutting back, entry-level roles are vanishing, and competition is exploding. AI is part of the story, but it’s also the perfect excuse.

This breakdown of why the job market is breaking reveals what’s really driving the collapse.
From corporate cost-cutting and investor pressure to oversupply of graduates and a system built on short-term profit.

If even Harvard can’t secure jobs anymore, what chance does anyone else have?

CHAPTERS:
0:00 - Harvard MBAs Struggling
1:04 - Hiring Cuts and Fewer Jobs
2:29 - AI vs Job Market Reality
3:11 - AI as Layoff Excuse
4:06 - Tech Oversupply Problem
5:18 - Layoffs and Job Shortage
6:27 - Slowing Industries and Hiring
8:03 - Inequality and Broken System

Narrated by: Josh Risser
